## Developer Guide

If you are new to using `nbdev` here are some useful pointers to get you
started.

### Install classroom_monitor in Development mode

``` sh
# make sure classroom_monitor package is installed in development mode
$ pip install -e .

# make changes under nbs/ directory
# ...

# compile to have changes apply to classroom_monitor
$ nbdev_prepare
```

## Usage

### Installation

Install latest from the GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/ForBo7/classroom-monitor):

``` sh
$ pip install git+https://github.com/ForBo7/classroom-monitor.git
```

or from [conda](https://anaconda.org/ForBo7/classroom-monitor)

``` sh
$ conda install -c ForBo7 classroom_monitor
```

or from [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/classroom-monitor/)

``` sh
$ pip install classroom_monitor
```

### Documentation

Documentation can be found hosted on this GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/ForBo7/classroom-monitor)’s
[pages](https://ForBo7.github.io/classroom-monitor/). Additionally you
can find package manager specific guidelines on
[conda](https://anaconda.org/ForBo7/classroom-monitor) and
[pypi](https://pypi.org/project/classroom-monitor/) respectively.
